_comment: Rows 790/794: bd-precut must name a missing/errored bd-footguns or bd-ratchet as UNKNOWN rather than silently dropping it, and its 'for what RAN (...)' verdict string must enumerate only the detectors that actually completed rc==0. Every anchor targets a DECISION the row790 patch added (the isfile presence check, the rc==0/rc==3 boundary, and the ran_parts membership tests) and inverts, widens or drops it; no anchor matches a value. The transform control lives in row790_precut_unknown_and_ran_transform_control.json and MUST escape. GENERATION 2 (row790b) adds L1/L2/L8, the three seams lens A1-A proved could be broken without turning the band red. They are re-expressed here as ZERO-WIDTH anchors (lookbehind/lookahead, empty matched span) with the literal moved into the inserted text, because tests/test_row357_mutant_anchors_are_not_fragile.py refuses a NEW anchor whose matched span carries a value-bearing token unless a producer record or a reasoned stable-value exception establishes its class. The lens spec at bd-persist/evidence/row790-lens-A1A-shape-mutants-20260914.json is untracked and so never met that gate; matching its literals verbatim here made row357 fail. The REGRESSION EACH ONE DRIVES IS UNCHANGED -- the append never executes, and the ran fallback claims both detectors ran -- and every variant was checked to COMPILE, so a verdict of CAUGHT cannot be an INVALID mutant misread.
subject: bd-precut names an absent or errored (rc not in {0,3}) bd-footguns/bd-ratchet as UNKNOWN by name, and its cut-ready verdict's ran string names only the detectors that actually ran clean

mutants.label: S1 footguns presence check inverted: a present tool is reported not-found
S2 footguns clean predicate widened to swallow any non-3 rc (the exact defect this row fixes)
S3 ratchet presence check inverted: a present tool is reported not-found
S4 ratchet clean predicate widened to swallow any non-3 rc
S5 the ran string claims footguns ran when footguns_ran is False
S6 the ran string claims the ratchet ran when ratchet_ran is False
S7 the ran/nothing branch is inverted: a real ran string is discarded for the literal "nothing"
L1 (lens A1-A ESCAPE, generation 1) suppress the footguns-absent unknown.append -- SEAM 1 absent half
L2 (lens A1-A ESCAPE, generation 1) suppress the ratchet-absent unknown.append -- SEAM 2 absent half
